d:
Ancient Unexplained Files reopens history's strangest cold cases to investigate enigmas science still can't explain, from monumental ruins to eerie legends from antiquity. Combining modern technology with on-the-ground detective work, experts test bold theories against hard archaeological evidence, only to uncover deeper puzzles from the ancient world. Experience the most perplexing discoveries and unanswered questions from across the globe.
Watch Ancient Unexplained Files Season 2 Episodes 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 & 9 on Discovery Channel India.
